name: badge
title: Badge
description: A short label beside content: a record's status in a pill (subtle or bold), a live state as a dot and a word, or a count.

when: Showing the state of an item: draft, paid, overdue.
Showing how many items need attention.

guidance.rule: The word carries the meaning, never the color alone; use sentence case.
Use the bold appearance sparingly, for the one status that matters most.
Use `danger` only for counts that need action now.

builtIn: Text meets WCAG AA in both appearances.
On an icon the badge is hidden; the control's label must say the count.
youProvide: A status word that makes sense without color.
The count in the control's accessible name when the badge sits on an icon.

genui.description: A numeric count next to a label. Use lozenge for status words.
